value_formula: otc_print(GPORQ, first print within 10 trading days after 2020-11-25) / last_close - 1
open_checks: price_ticker should be GPORQ not GPOR (symbol from fails rows)
verdict: Chapter 11 drop from Nasdaq, OTC as GPORQ, equity cancelled; library right except the price symbol GPOR.

verification.notes: 8-K 2020-11-20 (0001213900-20-038501) says Nasdaq delists at the open of 2020-11-27 and the stock is expected to trade on OTC Pink from 2020-11-30. Fails rows for CUSIP 402635304 show GPOR through 20201127 and GPORQ from 20201130 to 20210610. The 8-K of 2021-05-17 confirms the equity was cancelled without distribution. So the library's price_ticker GPOR is the Nasdaq symbol and the security's own OTC symbol is GPORQ. The symbol rests on fails rows, not an exchange print. Other fields were not disputed and not re-tested.
